title: Health and clinical tools
summary: Tools that help doctors and patients get to the right answer faster, from guideline search with citations to bedside calculators.

title: Full-stack platforms
summary: Multi-role products with real accounts, payments and dashboards, built for hotels, schools and tutoring companies.

title: Applied AI
summary: Language models, speech and retrieval put to work on concrete jobs: answering from documents, dubbing video, generating lessons.

title: Computer vision and accessibility
summary: Cameras and sensors that read, track and recognize, often for people who need a little extra help.

title: Robotics and simulation
summary: Simulated drones and robots that plan, inspect and learn, plus interactive simulations of math and physics.

title: Learning tools
summary: Apps that make learning feel like play, for kids, students and anyone brushing up on a skill.

title: Developer and productivity tools
summary: Browser and editor extensions and small utilities that remove friction from everyday work.
